summary: LIXTE BIOTECHNOLOGY HOLDINGS, INC. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) for a registered follow-on offering of 2,366,503 common shares and 258,859 pre-funded warrants at $6.31 each, total gross proceeds approximately $16.6 million. The offering was priced at a ~10.4% discount to the June 2, 2026 closing price of $7.04. There is no placement agent fee, and delivery is expected on June 4, 2026. This is a routine capital raise via a shelf takedown under an effective S-3; not a special situation. Use of proceeds is typical for working capital. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural complexity is present beyond the combination of shares and pre-funded warrants to accommodate accredited investors.
